original_title: Lufthansa becomes first major airline to ground planes as Iran war fuel crisis worsens

ai_analysis.detailed_analysis: Lufthansa grounding planes due to Iran war fuel crisis, triggering panic buying and stockpiling of jet fuel, potentially disrupting aviation operations and supply chains
ai_analysis.immediate_forecast_24h: Increased fuel prices, potential flight cancellations and delays, heightened security measures at airports
ai_analysis.strategic_outlook: Prolonged conflict may lead to sustained fuel shortages, impacting global air travel and logistics, with potential for further escalation and expansion of the crisis
ai_analysis.operational_impact: Disruption to air cargo and passenger services, potential for increased costs and reduced capacity, affecting the entire aviation and logistics industry
